pages.title: Ferocious
pages.text: The Zheng prowls the scorched lands, its voice like striking stone. Where it passes, sparks scatter from its claws, and even the wind carries a burning scent.

pages.title: Ferocious
pages.text: The Classic of Mountains and Seas records: upon Mount Zhang'e, barren of plants and rich in jade, there lives a beast shaped like a crimson leopard, with five tails and a single horn, whose cry is like striking stone — its name is Zheng. $(br)When the astral plague descended and the land withered for a thousand li, it became the Zheng's paradise. They race across the scorched earth like the wind, five tails trailing lines of prairie fire — said not to be destruction, but cleansing flames that burn the plague away.
